root_cause: CaseDocument.ingested_at was inferred by SQLAlchemy as TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE while the code writes UTC-aware datetimes.
After the failed flush/commit, the same AsyncSession remained in PendingRollbackError state while trying to mark ingestion as failed.
fixes: Explicit DateTime(timezone=True) mappings for domain UTC datetime fields.
Rollback-safe document ingestion repository transaction handling.
Regression tests for timezone mappings and failure rollback.
